relevance.rationale: Constructs algebraic Habiro cohomology: whenever a q-de Rham complex carries a q-Hodge filtration, an associated q-Hodge complex descends canonically to the Habiro ring, and this recovers the Habiro ring of a number field. Its sec. 1.4 recalls the K_3(F) -> Pic regulator on that ring and that q-series from perturbative Chern-Simons theory are sections of the resulting line bundles. The corpus has a substantial Habiro chapter (def:habiro-ring, qz-bicompletion, motivic-substrate-canonicity) and a Bloch-group/regulator chapter, and rem:quantum-bloch-group-framework-connection sits exactly at their intersection (tags: quantum-bloch-group, regulator, habiro; uses def:habiro-ring). motivic-substrate-canonicity asserts without a source that 'the Habiro ring is the universal target of the non-archimedean realizations' -- this is the nearest literature to that claim, though it is not the same statement (descent of a specific complex, not universality), so no proof is aided. Supporting, with a caveat: the primary for the number-field Habiro ring and its regulator is the four-author paper this one cites, which is also absent from references.ts.

keyResults.statement: The q-Hodge complex associated to a q-Hodge filtration descends canonically to the Habiro ring, and the construction recovers the Habiro ring of a number field.
keyResults.useForFolio: Gives the literature meaning of 'the Habiro ring as a descent/coefficient target for a q-deformed cohomology', which is the informal content of the Habiro bullet in motivic-substrate-canonicity.

keyResults.statement: The Habiro ring of a number field carries a regulator from K_3 into its Picard group, whose image line bundles have sections given by q-series from perturbative Chern-Simons theory; this geometry is invisible after (q-1)-completion.
keyResults.useForFolio: Directly parallels rem:quantum-bloch-group-framework-connection, which places the framework's traced volumes in a quantum Bloch group with a regulator to R and tags itself 'habiro'; it also identifies a missing primary reference (the number-field Habiro ring paper).

proposedActions.rationale: No ref() entry; the corpus has five Habiro entries but nothing on q-de Rham / Habiro cohomology, and no entry for the number-field Habiro ring it recovers.

The K_3 -> Pic regulator on the Habiro ring, with Chern-Simons q-series as sections, is a literature statement in the same shape as the corpus's Bloch-group/regulator picture; a remark recording the parallel (and its limits) is the honest linkage. Explicitly NOT aid-proof: the descent theorem is not the universality claim motivic-substrate-canonicity makes.
